skill.name: adspy-ad-library-tiktok-facebook
skill.description: Use the PipiAds MCP server to research TikTok and Facebook ads, look up Meta Ad Library records, and compare findings across sources.
skill.summary: Compare TikTok, Facebook, and Meta Ad Library results with PipiAds.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: The backtick matches are Markdown formatting, and most key references are setup declarations. The MCP configuration passes the API key to a globally installed command, and the setup directs users to a separate domain for keys and billing. Paid searches have no explicit credit limit, and no evidence of prompt injection or credential theft was found.

remediation.issue: The MCP configuration passes the API key to a command identified only by name.
remediation.suggestion: Bind the MCP configuration to a verified executable path. Inject only the provider credential needed by that process and keep it out of prompts and logs.

remediation.issue: Setup sends users to a separate domain for API keys and billing.
remediation.suggestion: Use a verified account link from the listed provider homepage. If a separate domain is required, document its ownership and link to the provider's confirmation.

remediation.issue: The installation metadata requests a global third-party npm installation.
remediation.suggestion: Use an isolated installation with verified package provenance and locked dependencies. Require explicit user approval before installing or starting the server.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not set a credit limit for searches or follow-up calls.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users to approve a credit limit before paid calls. Bound result counts and follow-up requests, and stop when the approved limit is reached.

content.value_statement: Comparing competitor ads across platforms is difficult when the results come from separate datasets. Use PipiAds to find ads, check details, and compare results by source.
actual_capabilities: Search TikTok and Facebook ads in the PipiAds Adspy dataset.
Look up details for Adspy ads, products, advertisers, and stores.
Search Meta Ad Library ads and products through PipiAds and retrieve their details.
Review store ad trends, delivery analysis, long-running ads, frequently used ads, and associated Facebook pages.
Compare source matches for a product, advertiser, or niche across TikTok, Facebook, and Meta Ad Library.
limitations: Live lookups require the PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key.
Queries can consume account credits. Searches are charged by result, while detail requests can incur a separate charge.
This skill does not provide ongoing monitoring, TikTok Shop analytics, or discovery of organic TikTok content.
Comparisons are limited to returned records. A missing match does not establish that an ad or advertiser is absent.

use_cases.title: Compare Creative Approaches
use_cases.description: Find ads in one product category and compare the openings and offers shown in TikTok and Facebook results.

use_cases.title: Check a Competitor's Ad Presence
use_cases.description: Look for an advertiser in Adspy and Meta Ad Library. Report confirmed matches and ambiguous names separately.

use_cases.title: Review a Store's Ad Activity
use_cases.description: Inspect a selected store's ad trends, delivery analysis, and longest-running ads to guide campaign research.

prompt_templates.title: Find Ads for a Product
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: search one dataset for a product category.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search PipiAds Adspy for TikTok ads about insulated lunch bags. Return up to five results with the advertiser and a brief description when available.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up a Library Ad
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: move from a search result to a detail record.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Meta Ad Library for [advertiser] through PipiAds. Show up to three matches and retrieve details only for the closest exact match.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Ads Across Sources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare the same category across datasets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search TikTok and Facebook Adspy plus Meta Ad Library for [product category]. Limit each source to five results. Compare visible offers and label any missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Store Within a Budget
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine store research with a credit limit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [store] and confirm the match with me. Estimate the credit cost of reviewing its ad trend, delivery analysis, and three long-running ads. Wait for approval before those follow-up calls.

output_examples.input: Compare TikTok and Facebook Adspy results for insulated lunch bags.
output: Illustrative comparison: One TikTok sample opens with a packing demonstration.
One Facebook sample highlights capacity and a bundle offer.
These examples describe the sampled ads and do not establish which approach performs better.

output_examples.input: Check whether a named advertiser appears in Facebook Adspy and Meta Ad Library.
output: Illustrative source check: Facebook Adspy returned one exact advertiser match.
Meta Ad Library returned a similar page name, but the available details did not confirm that it was the same advertiser.

best_practices: Specify whether to search Adspy, Meta Ad Library, or both before starting.
Set a result limit and approve a credit budget before requesting broad searches or multiple detail lookups.
Label each finding by source and keep uncertain matches separate from confirmed ones.
anti_patterns: Pasting an API key into a prompt instead of configuring it through the host environment.
Searching every source and retrieving every detail without an agreed credit budget.
Treating a long ad run as proof of sales, profitability, or conversion performance.

faq.question: Which ad sources can I search?
faq.answer: You can search PipiAds Adspy for TikTok and Facebook ads and use separate tools for Meta Ad Library records.

faq.question: What do I need before running searches?
faq.answer: You need the PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key. Confirm the provider's setup instructions before installing the server or entering billing details.

faq.question: How does the skill use my API key?
faq.answer: The configuration passes your key to the PipiAds MCP server through its environment. Do not include the key in prompts.

faq.question: How are queries charged?
faq.answer: The skill lists one credit per search result and one per detail request. It says detail requests are free when repeated within three days.

faq.question: Can I use this for organic TikTok or TikTok Shop research?
faq.answer: No. This workflow is for ad research, not organic TikTok discovery or TikTok Shop analytics.

faq.question: Does an empty result mean a competitor ran no ads?
faq.answer: No. An empty result only means the selected source returned no matches for that query.
